# LEGAL REVIEW & REDLINE MEMORANDUM

**PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT**
**Matter:** Project NeuralLex — Acquisition of NeuralLex Enterprise Systems, Inc. ("Target") by Acquirer Corp. ("Buyer")
**Deal File:** MNA-2026-6000 | **Prepared by:** Office of the Principal Legal Counsel, M&A Due Diligence & Complex Commercial Litigation

**Preliminary Note on the Record:** The Data Room contains two parallel, materially inconsistent sets of deal exhibits (Exhibits 001–004 vs. Exhibits 005–008). The second set (Exhibits 007–008) reflects a *materially worse* indemnification posture for Buyer: a lower escrow ($15.0M / 7.5% vs. $25.0M / 10.0%), a lower basket ($4.0M vs. $7.5M), a lower de minimis ($150K vs. $500K), fewer subprocessors (11 vs. 19), and a second unremediated GDPR Art. 33 breach (Incident #9781, June 30, 2025). This Memorandum analyzes **both** sets and assumes the executed SPA is the version most favorable to Sellers (Exhibit 007 set) unless Buyer's counsel confirms otherwise. **All redlines below are drafted against the Exhibit 007/008 set** and must be conformed if the Exhibit 001 set controls.
